title: BidWisely Procurement Matcher
description: Scrapes Nigerian/African procurement portals, uses GPT-4o-mini to extract structured tender data, matches opportunities to your SME profile, and generates an AI executive briefing.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Procurement listing URLs to crawl. Add as many portals as needed.

openAiApiKey.title: OpenAI API Key
openAiApiKey.description: Your OpenAI API key (starts with sk-). Required when 'Enable AI Extraction' is true. Leave blank and set enableAiExtraction to false to use the free heuristic extractor instead. Get a key at platform.openai.com/api-keys.

smeProfile.title: SME Profile
smeProfile.description: Your business profile. The matching engine uses this to score every opportunity.

services: Sale and Installation of Construction Aluminum roofing and ceiling materials

maxItems.title: Max Tenders to Process
maxItems.description: Maximum number of individual tender pages to extract and match. Keep low for demos.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max HTTP Requests
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Hard cap on total HTTP requests. Prevents runaway crawls.

keywords.title: Filter Keywords
keywords.description: If set, only process tender pages containing at least one of these keywords (case-insensitive).

enableAiExtraction.title: Enable AI Extraction
enableAiExtraction.description: Use GPT-4o-mini to extract structured fields. When disabled, falls back to a fast heuristic extractor (no API charges).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select proxies to be used. Apify Proxy is recommended to bypass blocks on sites like globaltenders.com.
